name: Bradwood Landing LNG Sendout Pipeline
researcher_notes: A Federal Energy Regulatory Commission court-case page says the agency authorized Bradwood Landing LLC and NorthernStar Energy LLC to build an LNG terminal on the Columbia River in Clatsop County, Oregon, and 36.3 miles of pipeline to Northwest Pipeline in Cowlitz County, Washington (order 124 FERC 61,257, 2008). An Oil and Gas Journal article from 2006 confirms the 36.3 mile length and a 1.3 Bcf per day sendout. The project was never built. No source stating a cancellation year was found, so status is cancelled by inference and the cancellation year is blank. Diameter, capacity unit rows and route not researched. Not a match to the existing Kelso-Beaver row P7790 or the Kalama lateral. Owner entity not in the gazetteer; legal form of NorthernStar Natural Gas not confirmed. Route is not mapped.
